# Portfolio Hub Utility Catalog

This file contains a list of all reusable utilities, hooks, and components in the repository.

## PDFEngine
- **Path:** lib/accessibility-utils.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Enterprise Accessibility Infrastructure

## FocusBridge
- **Path:** lib/accessibility-utils.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Generates a 1099 PDF payload that successfully passes the PAC

## designManifest
- **Path:** lib/design-manifest.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** AUTO-GENERATED DESIGN TOKENS

## parseGitHubUrl
- **Path:** lib/github.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Robust helper to parse owner and repository name from arbitrary GitHub URLs.

## getPersonSchema
- **Path:** lib/seo.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Returns the canonical Person schema representing Frederick de Ruiter.

## getSoftwareSourceCodeSchema
- **Path:** lib/seo.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Returns a specialized SoftwareSourceCode schema for dynamic Case Studies.

## usePersistentState
- **Path:** hooks/usePersistentState.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** A custom hook that works like useState but persists the state to localStorage.

## parseMarkdownToRichItems
- **Path:** hooks/usePretextLayout.tsx
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Tokenizes markdown-like inline text (**bold**, *italic*, `code`) into RichInlineItem arrays.

## useTelemetry
- **Path:** hooks/useTelemetry.ts
- **Model:** centralized reuse
- **Description:** Custom hook implementing a robust Stale-While-Revalidate (SWR) telemetry system.

## TelemetryTracker
- **Path:** components/TelemetryTracker.tsx
- **Model:** copy-and-paste
- **Description:** Lightweight Client Component tracker designed to silently capture page_view events on mount.
